description: Fetch liturgical calendar data, grouped by focus: current (today's season and cycle, uses tz); year (civil-year overview, requires year); seasons (season date ranges, requires year); special_days (all named holy days in a year); upcoming (holy days from today or date forward); feast (look up a feast by feastName); context (factual season, readings, and generic season theme labels for a date — not generated commentary). Shared params: tradition, tz, date, year. Use search_lectionary if the user names a season rather than a date.

date.description: Civil date for focus=context, or the "from" date for focus=upcoming.

feastName.description: Feast or holy day name, required when focus is feast. Examples: Christmas, Ash Wednesday, Trinity Sunday.

focus.description: Defaults to current. year and seasons require year; feast requires feastName; context requires date.

tradition.description: Lectionary tradition. rcl (default) is the Revised Common Lectionary; catholic is the Roman Catholic lectionary; episcopal is RCL Sundays with BCP Daily Office weekdays; bcp is the BCP Daily Office only.

tz.description: IANA time zone used to decide "today" and the current civil year, e.g. America/New_York, America/Chicago, Europe/London. Defaults to America/New_York (or LECTIO_TIMEZONE). Takes effect once the API tz parameter is deployed.

name: get_calendar
title: Get liturgical calendar
